trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies first; the platinum unlocks the moment the last one lands. Follow the roadmap in this guide: story first, then the contact strands and strangers, then collectibles and open-world feats, and finish with 100% completion. Nothing here needs a special trick, only every other trophy.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Gone Fishing. It appears as you play the main story, so keep following the story missions until it shows up, then complete it; the trophy pops when the mission ends. Missable in our reading: it is tied to one named mission, so play it when it comes rather than skipping past it.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 of the story. Play the opening missions in order; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Chapters cannot be skipped, so this one comes to every player who plays through the story.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 of the story. Keep playing the main story missions in order after Chapter 1; the trophy pops at the end of the chapter.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 of the story. Play the main story missions in order; the trophy pops when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 of the story. Play the main story missions in order; the trophy pops at the end of the chapter, just before the story's final stretch.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. It is the last story mission, after Chapter 4, so it comes at the end of the main story; the trophy pops when the mission ends and the credits roll.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. It appears as you play the main story, so follow the story missions until it shows up, then complete it. Missable in our reading: it is tied to one named mission, so play it when it comes.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. Follow the main story until the heist mission appears, prepare for it, then complete it; the trophy pops when the mission ends. Missable in our reading: it is tied to one named mission.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. Follow the main story until the mission appears, then complete it; the trophy pops when it ends. Missable in our reading: it is tied to one named mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. Follow the main story until the mission appears, then complete it; the trophy pops when it ends. Missable in our reading: it is tied to one named mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown. Follow the main story until the mission appears at Vice City International Airport, then complete it; the trophy pops when it ends. Missable in our reading: it is tied to one named mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Follow the main story until the mission appears, then complete it; the trophy pops when it ends. Missable in our reading: it is tied to one named mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion: every story mission, every contact strand, every stranger strand, every collectible set and every activity this guide tracks. Check the in-game stats for what is left and clear it piece by piece. For most players this is the last trophy before the platinum, so treat the rest of this guide as its checklist.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps and aerial tricks; repeat them across Leonida and watch the counter climb. Best done bit by bit alongside exploration rather than in one long sitting.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once: races, fishing, arcade games, the shooting range, drone races and the rest. One attempt at each is enough; you do not need to win any of them. Work through the activity list early so later trophies build on it.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through every challenge at the range and repeat any that falls short of gold until it passes. The count PlayStation tracks is 42, so the trophy pops when the last challenge turns gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Learn each course first, then win at least once per location; the trophy needs every location covered, not just one win anywhere.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter varied race types and win 20 distinct ones; repeating the same race does not add a new one. Mix cars, bikes and boats so the count climbs steadily.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge, out-fish him, and the trophy pops at the result screen. If you lose, challenge him again; the trophy only needs one win.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Play any arcade game through to its end; finishing is enough, and you do not need a high score. Pick the shortest game you find if you only want the trophy.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Follow Andy's mission strand to its end; the trophy pops when his last mission finishes. Missable in our reading: it is the final mission of one contact's strand, so finish it while the strand is open.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's mission strand to its end; the trophy pops when his last mission finishes. Missable in our reading: it is the final mission of one contact's strand.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's mission strand to its end; the trophy pops when his last mission finishes. Missable in our reading: it is the final mission of one contact's strand.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Take on stranger missions as you meet them while exploring; 8 full strands are needed, so keep an eye out in every region rather than rushing the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's mission strand to its end; the trophy pops when his last mission finishes. Missable in our reading: it is the final mission of one contact's strand.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's mission strand to its end; the trophy pops when his last mission finishes. Missable in our reading: it is the final mission of one contact's strand.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Find each meditation spot and meditate there once; the trophy needs every spot, so sweep the map region by region and tick them off as you go.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take Bret's hunt, track the unique animal he names, and bring it down; the trophy pops when the hunt is complete. Bring a scoped weapon and take the shot from cover.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Gather cards across Leonida until 3 full sets are complete; cards are the collectible the description counts, and a set only counts when every card in it is found. Collect as you explore so the sets finish naturally.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Find 100 WAiNK spots and use the app at each; the counter is 100, so this is a long sweep. Fold it into your exploration of Leonida and tick spots off region by region.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Work through the game's challenge list; any 50 count, so pick the easiest ones first and let the rest come from normal play. The challenge menu shows what is left.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears. Use alleys and tunnels to break the search, and do not split up.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner while keeping the same wanted level; getting caught or losing it resets the run. Plan a short route between three nearby shops before you start.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or enter 100 different vehicles; each new one adds to the count. Try everything you pass: cars, bikes, boats and anything rarer, since variety is what the counter wants.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus with at least 5 enemies in reach and drop all five before it ends. Pick a crowded fight, not a quiet one, so the targets are already there.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Get to Vice City International Airport and leave by an unscheduled route; the description leaves the exact exit open, so any departure that is not a scheduled flight counts in our reading. A stolen plane on the runway is the plainest way to try it.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The description names the Rhino tank and heat, so expect a feat involving the Rhino; the exact step is not pinned down by the description, and we do not invent one. Get into a Rhino and see what the game counts.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store, stay out of sight, take the goods and leave clean; being spotted fails the attempt, so move slowly and use the quietest route out.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Hit five bank vaults and get away after each one; the trophy counts completed escapes, so a vault robbed without an escape does not count. Plan your getaway before you go in.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush an armored truck, take its cargo and lose the heat. Block the truck first so it cannot drive off, then grab the goods and go.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Cover every region of the map; the trophy pops when the last area is revealed. Drive the highways, visit the islands and the countryside, and check the map for fog left uncovered.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Find and rob one illegal operation per gang; every gang must be hit, so keep a list of which gangs you have done and hunt the ones left.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, find a spot with a view and have a cocktail; the description does not name the exact bar, so treat the spot as unconfirmed and try the beachfront bars first.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a vehicle out through a showroom's front in the smash-and-grab style the description hints at; the exact showroom is not pinned down by the description, so try the most prominent showroom first.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Bowl at the Kolt & Associates alley and follow through; a finished game there is the plainest reading of the description.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is deliberately vague; it points at a partner activity done well, and the exact trigger is not pinned down by the description. We do not invent a step for it.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Make a story choice and live with it; the description points at a decision point, and the choice itself is not named. Missable in our reading: a choice, once made, may not come again, so think before you pick.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail or retry something once, then succeed on the second attempt; the description hints at a second try, and the exact moment is not named. Missable in our reading: if the first try must fail, a first-try success may lock it out.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The description points at a strange, unexplained event; expect an easter egg, and treat its location as unconfirmed. Keep an eye out for odd sights while exploring Leonida.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock targets over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, bowling-pin style. Find a group standing together, drive past slowly and swing.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills via your contacts until $250,000 is cleaned; the counter tracks laundered money, so keep feeding bills through as you earn them.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, food, gear and more across shops until $100,000 is spent in total; the counter is cumulative, so normal shopping counts toward it.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage property on the market; the trophy pops when the last one is yours. Save money for them early, since garages are also useful for the vehicle trophies.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register ten vehicles you own in the Scooter Bros app; any ten count, so use the cheapest vehicles you already own.
